summary: This 424B5 prospectus supplement discloses a registered direct offering of 1,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at $10.00 per share to M-COR Capital LLC, grossing $10,000,000. The price reflects a ~6.2% discount to the last trade of $10.66 on August 25, 2026. No placement agent or underwriter is used; shares deliver on August 26, 2026 subject to customary closing. This is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation event. Watch for dilution and use of proceeds, but no risk-arb angle applies.
